name: Bard War Chanter
body:
A war chanter sings songs specifically oriented toward pitched battle and keeping their allies up and fighting.

Inspire Toughness (Su)

At 1st level, a war chanter can use their performance to inspire toughness in their allies (including themselves). Any affected allies gain temporary hit points equal to 1/2 the war chanter’s class level (minimum 1). These temporary hit points are refreshed each round the performance is maintained and any remaining temporary hit points remain for 5 rounds after the performance ends.

This ability replaces fascinate.

Inspire Recklessness (Su)

At 6th level, a war chanter can instill a war fervor into their allies. The allies who choose to accept the benefit take a -3 penalty to AC to gain a +3 morale bonus to attack rolls. This increases by 1, for the penalty and bonus, at 10th level and every 4 levels thereafter.

This ability replaces suggestion.

Inspire Legion (Ex)

At 10th level, the war chanter extends the radius of their performance out to 60 feet.

This ability replaces jack-of-all-trades and the versatile performance gained at 10th level.

Inspire Despair (Su)

At 18th level, when you use inspire courage, all enemies within the radius must make a Will save DC (10 + 1/2 the war chanter’s class level + their Charisma modifier) or take a penalty to saving throws against charm and fear effects and attack and weapon damage rolls. The penalty is equal to the bonus provided by inspire courage.

This ability replaces mass suggestion.
